summary: Affected versions of highlight.js are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution. A malicious HTML code block with a crafted language name can pollute the base object's prototype during syntax highlighting, potentially causing application instability or crashes (Denial of Service) in applications that render user-provided code blocks.
